egress.rule: artifacts leave only into odyssey/experiments/, never the network

emergency_stop.rule: presence of this file halts every loop at the next checkpoint boundary

ingress.rule: artifacts enter only by content-addressed path

network.note: retrieval runs against a pinned snapshot, not the live web

process_isolation.kind: subprocess with explicit cwd and env

container.gate: ODYSSEY-ENV-01: digest is recorded on first clean build

mathlib.note: Tier 3 requires the pinned revision; a proof that needs a different Mathlib is a different proof.

tools.note: a tool not on this list is a permission event, not a refusal
